headline: Thursday's the day — work the triangle's cool south edge
body:
Today, Wednesday, carries a small-craft advisory in the outer waters — the Santa Rosa zone until noon, the offshore zone through this evening. The channel itself is easy: light winds, seas 2 to 4 ft, the triangle's middle near 4. But Santa Rosa Flats is ugly, 6.3 ft with NW gusts to 15. Thursday softens everywhere: channel seas 2 to 3 ft, light winds, the triangle around 3.3, the farther banks laying down. Thursday is the fishable day across the board.

Now the break. The triangle reads warm — west corner 71.6, east corner 71.2, south point 69.5, the coolest by a wide margin. The 64–68 band isn't inside the triangle at all; the nearest true break is at Santa Rosa Flats, 68.5 today. But that water sits under the advisory and slop right now, and warms to 70.5 by Thursday — so the run west isn't worth it either day.

Start at the south point, in the Santa Cruz Basin, on the coolest edge near 69.5–70, and push south toward the break. Go Thursday.
